verdict.rationale: Bun's default lockfile bun.lock is explicitly documented as a text-based, human/agent-readable format (v1.2+), replacing the binary bun.lockb, and docs explicitly market it as 'a lockfile you can read.' It supports diffing since it's plain text, and Bun even auto-migrates other lockfiles into it. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a formal lockfile schema/spec for programmatic parsing, and no independent hands-on confirmation of diff-friendliness beyond vendor docs.
